name: Pit Wall
author: Jeremy Longshore
description: Pit Wall turns your Omarchy bar into a Formula 1 race-weekend command post. Between sessions it counts down to FP1, qualifying, sprint, or race start; while running it shows the leader, gaps, flags, safety-car state, and live leaderboard. Open the panel for the local-time weekend schedule plus driver/constructor standings. It reads keyless Jolpica schedule/standings data every 15 minutes and OpenF1 every 20 seconds only during sessions. It writes no files outside Quickshell's own state handling.
